Function Walked(things As Object) As String
    Dim one As Object, n As Long
    For Each one In things
        n = n + 1
    Next
    Walked = "walked" & n
End Function

Function Probe() As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, data As Worksheet, ws As Worksheet, pt As Object, s As String, v As String
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet): Set data = wb.Worksheets(1)
    data.Range("A1:B1").Value = Array("Region", "Amount")
    data.Range("A2:B2").Value = Array("East", 1)
    data.Range("A3:B3").Value = Array("West", 2)
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets.Add
    Set pt = wb.PivotCaches.Create(xlDatabase, data.Range("A1:B3")).CreatePivotTable(ws.Range("A3"), "P")
    pt.PivotFields("Region").Orientation = xlRowField
    pt.AddDataField pt.PivotFields("Amount"), "Total", xlSum
    On Error Resume Next
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = TypeName(pt.Slicers)
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = pt.Slicers.Count
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = TypeName(pt.Slicers.Parent)
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = TypeName(pt.Slicers.Application)
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = pt.Slicers(1).Name
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = TypeName(pt.CalculatedFields.Application)
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = TypeName(pt.CalculatedFields.Parent)
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = pt.CalculatedFields.Count
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = TypeName(pt.PivotFields("Region").CalculatedItems.Application)
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = TypeName(pt.PivotFields("Region").CalculatedItems.Parent)
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = pt.PivotFields("Region").CalculatedItems.Count
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = Walked(pt.Slicers)
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = Walked(pt.CalculatedFields)
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = Walked(pt.PivotFields("Region").CalculatedItems)
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "," & v
    On Error GoTo 0
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    wb.Close False
    Probe = Mid$(s, 2)
End Function
